item.title: Avon Technologies wins $12m European NATO respiratory protection order
item.summary: Avon Technologies has secured a roughly $12m order for chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) respiratory protection equipment from an existing European customer. Avon has won a string of similar orders in recent months as the group builds momentum in the area.
